title: Hi, Fifteen-Year-Old Me

pre.en: What does Tom think counts as a pet?
pre.zh: Tom 觉得什么也能算宠物？

intro: 融汇课：刘洋翻出了 2011 年周老师让大家写给未来自己的信，要每人在线上聚会时给当年的自己回个话。三十岁的小陈录了一段视频，对十五岁的自己说话。回头看的几种说法都在这里：过去完成时、wish 和 If only、第三条件句、should have。读的时候留意每句说的是现在还是过去。最后他才回答那三个问题。

sentences.en: Hi, fifteen-year-old Chen.
sentences.zh: 嗨，十五岁的小陈。

sentences.en: Last week Liu Yang found the letters Mrs Zhou had made us write in 2011, and he wants replies for our online get-together.
sentences.zh: 上个星期，刘洋把 2011 年周老师让我们写给未来自己的信翻了出来，要大家在线上聚会时给当年的自己回个话。

sentences.en: You asked me three questions: Am I rich? Do I have a dog? Did I marry Zhang Min?
sentences.zh: 你在信里问了我三个问题：我有钱吗？我养狗了吗？我娶了张敏吗？

sentences.en: First, you're going to fail next month's maths exam, and it'll feel like the end of the world.
sentences.zh: 先说件事：下个月的数学考试你会考砸，到时候你会觉得天都塌了。

sentences.en: Don't be so hard on yourself.
sentences.zh: 别对自己那么狠。

sentences.en: Cry for one evening, then move on.
sentences.zh: 哭一个晚上，然后就翻篇。

sentences.en: You've survived worse, remember?
sentences.zh: 更糟的你都熬过来了，记得吧？

sentences.en: On your first day, you'd been sitting in the wrong building for forty minutes before anyone noticed.
sentences.zh: 上中学第一天，你在错的楼里坐了四十分钟，才有人发现。

sentences.en: Believe it or not, it'll all be for the best.
sentences.zh: 信不信由你，这一切到头来都是好事。

sentences.en: If you hadn't failed that exam, you'd never have chosen computer science.
sentences.zh: 要不是那次考砸了，你根本不会去选计算机。

sentences.en: And that was a real turning point.
sentences.zh: 那可是一个真正的转折点。

sentences.en: I know you've already got a plan in mind: football.
sentences.zh: 我知道你心里早有打算了：踢足球。

sentences.en: When Liu Yang starts a school team, say "Count me in" — but don't give up computers.
sentences.zh: 刘洋组校队的时候，你就说「算我一个」——不过电脑可别丢下。

sentences.en: About Mrs Zhou: she's strict with you because she believes in you.
sentences.zh: 关于周老师：她对你严，是因为她相信你行。

sentences.en: Try to take in everything she says, even the jokes.
sentences.zh: 她说的每句话都尽量听进去，连笑话也是。

sentences.en: They'll bring English to life about a week later.
sentences.zh: 大概一个星期以后，那些笑话会让英语真正鲜活起来。

sentences.en: I should have thanked her properly before I left.
sentences.zh: 我毕业前本该好好谢谢她的。

sentences.en: I also wish I'd stood up for myself more, so please start now.
sentences.zh: 我还后悔自己当年没多为自己说句话，所以请你从现在就开始。

sentences.en: Get into the habit of saving a little every month.
sentences.zh: 养成每个月存一点钱的习惯。

sentences.en: One day you'll share a flat in England with a man called Tom to keep costs down.
sentences.zh: 将来有一天，为了省钱，你会在英国跟一个叫 Tom 的人合租。

sentences.en: But treat yourself to a second bowl of noodles sometimes — the ones in England aren't that good.
sentences.zh: 不过偶尔也犒劳一下自己，多吃一碗面——英国的面可没那么好吃。

sentences.en: Lend your Harry Potter book to Liu Yang.
sentences.zh: 把你那本《哈利·波特》借给刘洋吧。

sentences.en: He'll keep it in good condition for fifteen years — he just won't finish it.
sentences.zh: 他会替你好好保存十五年——就是一直看不完。

sentences.en: And make time for Mum and Dad's Sunday phone calls.
sentences.zh: 还有，爸妈每个星期天打来的电话，一定要抽时间好好接。

sentences.en: If only I'd realised that sooner.
sentences.zh: 要是我早点明白这一点就好了。

sentences.en: I wish I could send this back to 2011.
sentences.zh: 真希望能把这段视频发回 2011 年。

sentences.en: Anyway, your questions.
sentences.zh: 好了，回到你那几个问题。

sentences.en: Not rich.
sentences.zh: 没钱。

sentences.en: Zhang Min has twins and a lovely husband.
sentences.zh: 张敏有一对双胞胎，还有个特别好的老公。

sentences.en: And no dog.
sentences.zh: 也没狗。

sentences.en: But Tom says a cactus counts as a pet.
sentences.zh: 不过 Tom 说，仙人掌也算宠物。

cards.note: to criticise yourself too much or expect too much from yourself
cards.tip: 对别人苛刻是 be hard on sb：Don't be so hard on him。常和 so、too 连用。
cards.example: You made one small mistake — stop being so hard on yourself.

cards.note: to stop thinking about something bad that happened and start thinking about other things
cards.tip: 也可以是「（换个话题）接着往下说」：Let's move on to the next point。从什么里走出来用 from。
cards.example: It's been a year since they broke up — it's time to move on.

cards.note: survive worse 是「比这更糟的都熬过来了」；名词 survival。

cards.zh: 信不信由你；说来你可能不信
cards.note: used before saying something surprising but true

cards.zh: （结果）是最好的安排；塞翁失马
cards.note: if something is for the best, it seems bad now but will have a good result later
cards.tip: 常加 all：It's all for the best；多用来安慰别人或自己。
cards.example: I didn't get the job, but maybe it's for the best.

cards.note: 大学专业名称，不加 the；读这个专业：study computer science。
a time when an important change happens, especially one that makes things better
cards.tip: 在什么中的转折点用 in：a turning point in my life；常和 be、become、mark 连用。
cards.example: Moving to London was a turning point in her career.

cards.note: to have an idea or plan about what you want
used to say that you want to join an activity or plan
to make someone follow rules and behave well, and not allow them to break the rules
cards.tip: 对人用 with，对某件事用 about：strict about homework。
cards.example: Our coach is strict with us, but we've never played better.

cards.note: believe sb 是相信某人说的话；believe in sb 是相信这个人行。

cards.zh: 理解并记住（听到、读到的东西）
cards.note: to understand and remember something that you hear or read
cards.tip: 代词放中间：take it in；名词可以放后面：take in everything。
cards.example: The lecture was so fast that I couldn't take it all in.

cards.note: to make something more interesting or exciting
英式口语很常用：Do it properly!（好好做！）
to defend yourself when someone treats you badly or unfairly
cards.tip: yourself 跟着人称变：stand up for myself；为别人出头是 stand up for sb。
cards.example: You need to stand up for yourself in meetings, or people will ignore you.

cards.text: get into the habit of doing
cards.note: to start doing something regularly so that it becomes a habit
to stop the amount of money you spend from getting higher
cards.tip: costs 用复数；也说 keep prices down。
cards.example: We cook at home most nights to keep costs down.

cards.zh: 犒劳自己；给自己买点好的
cards.note: to buy or do something special for yourself that you enjoy
通常用复数；一碗面 a bowl of noodles。
not damaged, and working or looking as it should

cards.zh: 抽出时间陪（某人）；为……留出时间
cards.note: to find time to spend with someone or to do something, even when you are busy
cards.tip: 后面也能接事情：make time for exercise；比 have time for 更主动，是「挤出来的时间」。
cards.example: However busy you are, make time for your kids.

cards.note: 英式拼写 realise，美式 realize。
复数 cacti 或 cactuses。
